compiled_state.title: Create append_review_cycle.py writer utility with schema validation, lazy migration, and atomic fcntl-locked append
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Story DD Coverage
- dd-1: Shared writer utility performs atomic append with exact 5-field schema: n (int), draft_hash (sha256 of DELTA OUTPUT block), findings_count (int), verdict (enum), timestamp_iso (RFC3339)
- dd-2: Graceful migration — initialize cycles[] when key missing, no overwrite of other fields
- dd-5: Migration fixture passes: artifact without cycles[] → cycles[] of length 1 after first write

## Testing Mode
RED (bundled: create test fixture + create utility in same commit — Gate 2 requires both)

## Files to Modify
- plugins/dso/scripts/append_review_cycle.py (Create — writer utility)
- tests/scripts/test-append-review-cycle.sh (Create — unit + migration tests)

## Implementation Notes
Create append_review_cycle.py as pure-stdlib CLI: fcntl.flock(LOCK_EX) on sibling .lock file, read-modify-write, obj.setdefault('cycles', []) for lazy migration, append entry with 5 fields, write via tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile + os.replace. CLI: python3 append_review_cycle.py --artifact <path> --n <int> --draft-hash <sha256> --findings-count <int> --verdict <enum> [--timestamp-iso <rfc3339>]. Verdict enum: pass, fail, escalate. Other artifact keys must be preserved.

## Acceptance Criteria
1. append_review_cycle.py exists at plugins/dso/scripts/append_review_cycle.py and is importable
2. tests/scripts/test-append-review-cycle.sh exists and is executable
3. Test asserts: appending to artifact with existing cycles[] preserves prior entries + adds new entry with 5 fields + correct types
4. Test asserts: appending to artifact WITHOUT cycles[] initializes to [] and first append yields len(cycles)==1
5. Test asserts: other artifact keys (producer, findings, tier) preserved unchanged after append
6. Test asserts: draft_hash field on appended entry equals the --draft-hash CLI value
7. Test asserts: CLI rejects unknown verdict values with non-zero exit
8. Run: bash tests/scripts/test-append-review-cycle.sh → PASS
9. Run: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/append_review_cycle.py → PASS

comments.body:
GAP_ANALYSIS_AC_AMENDMENT (1/5): Define cycles[] schema contract as single source of truth

Amend AC to add:
- Document the authoritative schema (field names, types, required/optional) inside append_review_cycle.py (module docstring or schema constant)
- Writer must reject writes with unknown/missing fields (non-zero exit, parseable error)
- Tests assert the exact field set: n (int), draft_hash (str, sha256), findings_count (int), verdict (enum), timestamp_iso (str, RFC3339)
- Prevents field-name drift across the 3 parallel downstream touchpoints (tasks 3/4/5)

comments.body:
GAP_ANALYSIS_AC_AMENDMENT (2/5): Migration idempotency and lock-coupling

Amend AC to add:
- Migration is idempotent: re-running append against already-migrated artifact is a no-op (no duplicate cycles[] entries)
- Migration is performed under the same fcntl lock as the append (read → migrate if needed → append → write, all under LOCK_EX)
- Migration failure leaves original artifact untouched (temp-file + rename pattern guarantees this)
- Test asserts: running append_review_cycle.py twice against same artifact → len(cycles)==2, not 1 (idempotency from caller perspective)

GAP_ANALYSIS_AC_AMENDMENT (3/5): Error-path contract for downstream touchpoints

Amend AC to add:
- Writer exits with documented non-zero codes for: schema-validation-failure, lock-acquisition-timeout, migration-failure, artifact-not-found, JSON-parse-failure
- stderr emits exactly one machine-parseable line per failure: APPEND_REVIEW_CYCLE_ERROR: code=<name> path=<artifact> detail=<...>
- On any failure, artifact is unchanged on disk (atomic write guarantee)
- Tests cover at least: artifact-not-found (non-existent path), JSON-parse-failure (corrupted artifact), invalid verdict enum
